variants.name: rt_df_2head
variants.decision: reject: negligible 2048-cycle gain with substantial resource increase

variants.name: rt_explicit_4head
variants.decision: no interval improvement over explicit 2-head scheduling

variants.name: rt_attn2_ff4
variants.decision: fastest measured bit-exact candidate; fits C-synthesis estimate with only 3003 LUT remaining

variants.name: rt_prefix_opt1
variants.change: factor-4 K/V projection reductions (vs attn2_ff4 factor-2)
variants.decision: REJECTED: measured WORSE than attn2_ff4 (+65,536 cycles, +LUT). K/V projection is fill-limited; a wider (factor-4) add-tree deepens the pipeline so per-output fill grows 14->23. factor-2 is the sweet spot.

variants.name: rt_prefix_opt2
variants.change: FUSED K+V projection into one (r,o) loop nest (share the per-output pipeline fill; same 2+2 MAC lanes)
variants.decision: ACCEPTED: new fastest fitting bit-exact candidate. K/V prefix 1,966,080->983,040 (fused pays per-output fill once); interval 7,212,718->6,229,677 (1.158x), LUT slightly LOWER (49,889 vs 50,197). Fits 7020. Still not real-time (gap 3.04x).

variants.name: rt_kv_dataflow
variants.change: split fused K+V projection into concurrent DATAFLOW processes (df_split_x || df_kproj || df_vproj); x duplicated to xk/xv for the dataflow single-reader rule
variants.decision: REJECTED: DATAFLOW concurrency WAS inferred (K and V run in parallel, region ~983,044) but the top interval did NOT improve (6,229,681 vs prefix_opt2 6,229,677) because fusion already realized the concurrency; AND BRAM overflows the device (296/280 = 105%) due to the xk/xv input duplication. Two stop conditions.

measured_bottleneck.interpretation: Fusing K+V halved the K/V projection prefix. The query dataflow region (4,893,100) is now the hard floor: even a zero-cycle prefix would leave 4,893,100 cycles = 2.39x the 2,048,000 budget. Reducing the query region needs more attention parallelism, which the ~94% LUT budget cannot afford. Real-time is therefore not achievable for this unchanged bit-exact architecture on the 7020 C-synthesis budget.

scope_caveat: C-synthesis estimates only; no place-and-route, bitstream, DMA integration, or board validation
fastest_fitting_candidate: rt_prefix_opt2 (interval 6,229,677 cycles, 62.30 ms, gap 3.042x) -- unchanged; kv_dataflow neither improves interval nor fits
realtime_lower_bound_note: MEASURED query dataflow region; serial with the prefix, so it is a hard floor for total interval. ANALYTICAL: 4,893,100/2,048,000 = 2.39x > 1, so real-time is unreachable without reducing the query region (LUT-blocked at ~94%).
